pr_title: Forbid negative time snap in editor
pr_body:
Closes #21944 

Initially i wanted to somehow make it properly round to nearest positive beat, but stuck on dealing with edge cases so ended with `if(n<0) n+=x` thing to avoid overcomplicating.

review_comments: To save me going through the whole process, can you explain why this change was required?

The test is placing 2 circles. Before this PR first one was placed on negative time, so they started to stack on the same beat. I changed this to make them placed on different beats to actually contribute to map's length.
Likewise, can you explain why the changes in this file were required?

Test was working from point's start time so created objects on negative time. It can't work now (will round to 0 and upper) so i didn't spend too much time investigating this, just moved all operations to positive time.
